overclaims: The report supports substantial differences in training method and serious caution about deployment.
checks.note: Excerpt and proposition match, and axis, horizon and outcome (unresolved) agree with the reviews. Fail 1: e6's public excerpt cuts the quote to "require further research", dropping what needs research (harm-mitigation tools) and "before these agents are deployed". That hides the basis for the deployment-caution sentence. Fail 2: e6 only says Gato was trained offline with supervised learning. It never compares this with how the brain works or children learn, so "substantial differences" is the drafter's own inference, not something the evidence states.
